blocks.text: Ecstasy Addiction – Of the many different kinds of drug-related problems in Canada, ecstasy addiction happens to be one of the most common. In 2004, about 4 percent of the country’s population have had used ecstasy at least once in their lifetime. The use of this kind of drug usually starts at a very young age wherein tenth graders boys and girls (8 percent are boys and 5 percent are girls) make use of it.

blocks.text: In the previous years, there have been deaths that have been associated with ecstasy. In many cases, these deaths have been a result of heatstroke due to moving and dancing for an extended period of time without changing lost body fluids. What is really dangerous is that there are some drugs which are sold on the market as ‘ecstasy’ that actually contain other types of drugs that can be too dangerous. Taking in ecstasy with alcohol or any other drugs also increases risks of adverse reactions.

blocks.text: Persons with any of the following conditions can have greater chances of developing psychological and physical harm by using ecstasy: heart disease, hypertension, epilepsy, liver problems, mental illness history and panic attacks. On the other hand, persons who are overdosed with ecstasy often show warning signs of overheating and dehydration. If any of these signs occur, stop dancing or moving and sip a cold glass of water while splashing some of it on your skin. Rest and cool down in a cool and quiet area as you continue fanning yourself. If these don’t work, get yourself to the nearest hospital.

Ecstasy Addiction

Ecstasy Addiction: What is it?

Ecstasy Addiction – Of the many different kinds of drug-related problems in Canada, ecstasy addiction happens to be one of the most common. In 2004, about 4 percent of the country’s population have had used ecstasy at least once in their lifetime. The use of this kind of drug usually starts at a very young age wherein tenth graders boys and girls (8 percent are boys and 5 percent are girls) make use of it.

Ecstasy Description

Ecstasy is a kind of drug that belongs to the ‘entactogen’ family which literally denotes ‘touching within’. Other kinds of drugs that belong in this family also include MDE, MDMA and MBDB. Generally, ecstasy is taken orally.

Find A Drug Rehab

Ecstasy Dependency

In the previous years, there have been deaths that have been associated with ecstasy. In many cases, these deaths have been a result of heatstroke due to moving and dancing for an extended period of time without changing lost body fluids. What is really dangerous is that there are some drugs which are sold on the market as ‘ecstasy’ that actually contain other types of drugs that can be too dangerous. Taking in ecstasy with alcohol or any other drugs also increases risks of adverse reactions.

Find A Drug Rehab

Ecstasy Addiction Withdrawal Symptoms

Ecstasy is a drug that is psychologically addicting. A person who is suffering from ecstasy addiction and is struggling to fight it has the following signs and withdrawal symptoms to show:

  • Anxiety
  • Depression
  • Sleeplessness
  • Panic attacks
  • Realization
  • Personalization
  • Paranoid delusions
Find A Drug Rehab

Long-Term Use of Ecstasy

Persons with any of the following conditions can have greater chances of developing psychological and physical harm by using ecstasy: heart disease, hypertension, epilepsy, liver problems, mental illness history and panic attacks. On the other hand, persons who are overdosed with ecstasy often show warning signs of overheating and dehydration. If any of these signs occur, stop dancing or moving and sip a cold glass of water while splashing some of it on your skin. Rest and cool down in a cool and quiet area as you continue fanning yourself. If these don’t work, get yourself to the nearest hospital.

Find A Drug Rehab

Fast Facts

People of young ages are the common users of ecstasy and one common sign of the growing use of this drug is the increasing popularity of underground ravens and clubs. These are places which are commonly raided by authorities and where many overdosed teenagers fall as victims.
